summary: Comprehensive backend testing of Card Database Backbone (Day 4) + Display Case (Day 5-7) features. All 32 tests passed (100%). All new endpoints working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Code is well-structured with proper admin permission checks
CSV import uses upsert pattern correctly (no duplicates on re-import)
Card search correctly falls back to eBay when local DB has no match
eBay fallback gracefully returns empty when API keys not configured (expected)
Tier logic correctly identifies users within 10-day trial as 'pro'
Owner-only access properly enforced on binders/pulls (403 for non-owners)
Cascade delete working - deleting binder removes all its pulls
seed_data_creation: Sample checklist CSV imported with 11 Prizm Football 2024 cards including Patrick Mahomes Silver Prizm (#245)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Day 4-7 features tested and working: (1) Admin CSV import with upsert - no duplicates on re-import. (2) Card search returns source:'local_db' for matches, source:'none' for no match (eBay keys not configured - expected). (3) Display Case binders/pulls CRUD fully working. (4) Tier logic: admin and new users get 'pro' (10-day trial). (5) Owner-only permissions enforced (403 for non-owners). (6) Platform fee is 2%. Test credentials: admin@flipnrip.com / AdminPass123!

admin_cards_import.notes: CSV upload working. Upsert prevents duplicates. Admin-only (403 for non-admin).

admin_cards_sets.notes: Returns distinct sets with year and count. Admin-only.

admin_cards_clear.notes: Can clear all or filter by set_name+year. Admin-only.

cards_search.notes: card_number+set_name+year returns local_db match (Mahomes Silver Prizm). Broad q=Mahomes works. Non-existent returns source:'none' (eBay fallback empty - expected).

display_case_packs.notes: Binder creation includes set_search from checklist_set. List returns tier='pro' for admin. Delete cascades to pulls.

display_case_pulls.notes: Pull from local_db returns source:'local_db' with player/team. Manual entry works. No card_number+player returns 400. Delete decrements pulls_count.

display_case_stats.notes: Returns total_packs, total_pulls, weekly_packs, tier, by_sport.

tier_logic.notes: Admin user and new users within 10-day trial get tier='pro'. Free tier limit is 2 packs/7 days.

permissions.notes: Non-owner cannot view/delete/add to another user's binder (403).

regression.notes: Auth (login/me), analyzer, predictor, hot-packs, health all working.
